run_biclustering_newsgroups: run spectral co-clustering biclustering on the twenty newsgroups dataset with TF-IDF vectorization
build_vectorizer_number_normalizing: build a NumberNormalizingVectorizer that extends TfidfVectorizer to map numeric tokens to a placeholder
test_spectral_coclustering: test SpectralCoclustering on a document-term matrix and retrieve row and column bicluster labels
review_bicluster_ncut: review the bicluster_ncut function that computes normalized cut scores for bicluster quality evaluation
summarize_mini_batch_kmeans: summarize MiniBatchKMeans clustering results on TF-IDF document vectors and compute v-measure score
